## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature (bumps minor)
- [ ] fix — bug fix (bumps patch)
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] ci — pipeline / tooling
- [ ] deps — dependency bumps
- [ ] chore — other
